verdict.rationale: ADP's own docs say RUN will create and deliver W-2 and 1099 forms and e-file them with the IRS on the employer's behalf, and employees can access their W-2s/1099s online. That covers generation and distribution to workers as a managed service, though it carries an additional fee. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic year-end timing or triggering, detail on delivery methods (paper vs. electronic) and deadlines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end

citations.quote: We’ll create and deliver W-2 and 1099 forms for you (additional fee), and even e-file these forms with the IRS on your behalf.
Employees can view pay history and up to three years of W-2s/1099s
